def fulldiff(prev, cur):
    a = prev.ascii.split('\n'); b = cur.ascii.split('\n')
    ch = []
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(a[i])):
            if a[i][j] != b[i][j]: ch.append((i,j,a[i][j],b[i][j]))
    return ch
for k in range(2):
    r = action(['UP'])
    ch = fulldiff(previous_frame, current_frame)
    # group by row
    rows={}
    for i,j,o,n in ch: rows.setdefault(i,[]).append((j,o,n))
    print(f"UP#{k+1} changed rows:", {i: v for i,v in rows.items()})
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP:", r); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def fulldiff(prev, cur):
    a = prev.ascii.split('\n'); b = cur.ascii.split('\n')
    ch = []
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(a[i])):
            if a[i][j] != b[i][j]: ch.append((i,j,a[i][j],b[i][j]))
    return ch
for k in range(2):

    # group by row
    rows={}
    for i,j,o,n in ch: rows.setdefault(i,[]).append((j,o,n))
    print(f"UP#{k+1} changed rows:", {i: v for i,v in rows.items()})
